pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark brown regions exhibit semi-polygonal and irregular geometries with jagged, non-linear edge gradients. The spatial area of patches is highest on the upper neck and mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented pixel clusters on the lower flank and forelimb transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of cream-colored negative space separates the patches. Junction nodes typically show tri-radial or quadri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank but displays increased frequency of nodes in the lower-ventral area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the upper neck displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile consisting of short, upright hair clusters. The contour is largely uniform in height across the visible neck segment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, linear, horizontal mark of light-colored pigment is visible across a dark patch on the central flank, indicative of a superficial cutaneous scar.
